label: Bible Study
prompt: The LORD is _____, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
verse: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
note: Moses quotes God's own self-description from Sinai back to him while pleading for Israel's pardon.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Giving _____ always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verse: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
note: Giving thanks always, for all things — Paul doesn't leave much room for exceptions.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Pharaoh took off his _____ from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
verse: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
note: From prison to palace in one day: Pharaoh's own ring, fine linen, and a gold chain for the dream interpreter.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your _____ are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
verse: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
note: Forty years in the desert and not one worn-out cloak or sandal — God's quiet wardrobe miracle.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is _____.
verse: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
note: Proverbs doesn't soften it: love instruction and you love knowledge; hate reproof and you're 'brutish.'
